scope: P12-P18 supplemental local-session evidence; case-level review, not group-level discharge

execution_verification.suite: Complete repository pytest suite, independently confirmed by the root agent and its final run log.
execution_verification.meaning: verified_scoped confirms the cited assertions in the final frozen implementation tree, within each case-specific fixture/provider scope. It does not discharge publisher evidence, external surfaces or final P19-P21 obligations.

post_suite_distribution_confirmation.scope_limit: Distribution smoke evidence does not by itself discharge all P20 obligations.

status_definitions.partial_evidence: A new test exercises only a proper subset of the source case; the case remains open.
status_definitions.baseline_only: Earlier scoped evidence remains authoritative; this review adds no new case-level assertion.
status_definitions.pending: No direct new case-specific evidence establishes the requirement.
status_definitions.external_pending: An external durable-host or actual MCP/application promise remains outside this local core evidence.
status_definitions.verified_scoped: The cited regression assertions passed in the final frozen code tree and directly exercise the stated mechanism within the recorded local/fixture scope; full publisher or external guarantees are not inferred.

publisher_scope.evidence: All 57 source IDs and 156 declaration dispositions resolve. Controlled tests cover a monetary workbook, escrow history and DBF field geometry for 134/803. The finite canonical SORS fixture retains ten required source publications and three portfolio constraint-variable sets through narrow projection; unavailable solver capability remains a qualified failure.
publisher_scope.open: Publisher historical layouts and economic/financial models for 134/803 remain separately unclosed. The SORS fixture uses a controlled physical-to-observation adapter and does not establish actual publisher parsing or broad publication-model coverage.

publisher_scope.evidence: SME literal JSON evidence, several constructed 1-YUR column epochs/formula evidence, source-local projections and retained replay use canonical commands.
publisher_scope.open: Deterministic historical-format fixtures establish their declared epochs; a universal proof of all publisher editions is not asserted.

publisher_scope.evidence: Ten fiscal table identities and three NWF document routes execute against controlled fixtures; mixed units, YTD/stock semantics and explicit conversion provider contracts are retained.
publisher_scope.open: Actual reviewed economic fields across the three NWF publisher document series and a real external historical DOC conversion engine remain publisher/provider obligations.

publisher_scope.evidence: All fourteen source IDs run the controlled workbook/profile route; exact geometry, anchors, periods, provenance and independent archive/cleanup effects are tested.
publisher_scope.open: The tests explicitly mark publisher_layouts_verified false. The fourteen licensed publisher semantic layouts are not established by source cards or synthetic workbooks.

publisher_scope.evidence: KEP2 eleven-indicator mixed-frequency and monthly product routes use a controlled workbook. Publisher-derived retained cell excerpts cover municipal population 2022/2023/2024 and selected industrial indices from the 2026-06 regional archive.
publisher_scope.open: Retained excerpts cover only the stated rows/years and preserve original identities by provenance; they are not complete publisher originals. Other regional tables and national-report PDF geometry require their own reviewed layouts.

later_phase_scope.P19: Final public SDK/ad-hoc/machine surface migration and protocol acceptance remain separately owned.
later_phase_scope.P20: Distribution smoke checks are recorded separately in the release validation; full P20 packaging, documentation and optional-dependency acceptance remains separately owned.
later_phase_scope.P21: Removal of all transitional owners and final full-inventory gate remain separately owned.
later_phase_scope.H01: Actual durable host restart/recovery guarantees remain external.
later_phase_scope.H02: Actual deployed MCP/application task service guarantees remain external.
